author: Stephen Dolgin
text: Maggio and sons were referred as prompt reliable and skilled. They were. The company. Has a strong crew, lots of equipment, experience and know how. They did just what they said they would do. We didn’t want shiny black surface on our old farmhouse.

author: Anu Mittal
text: Our experience working with Artie Maggio was a great one. We got a beautiful good sized patio made by them in 3 days He listened to all we wanted and how we wanted . Took care of all the paper work needed to be done to get the construction approved. We are so happy that we decided to work with them. We strongly recommend him for any such quality work.

author: paul VanDenburgh
text: As usual Peter & Artie and crew did a very professional job. We like the stone infused topping very much and it tapered right to our deck which is perfect as we can use it if we need to have accessible items like a chair lift!

author: Dianne Lugo
text: Maggio and Sons company is a professional, knowledgeable business with a great team/crew of individuals who were prompt, efficient, and took care of all the details.  From the estimate appointment to job completion, they were always on time , were there when they said they would be there, and finished the job quickly and exactly the way I wanted it done.  No complaints, would definitely recommend them.  Peter and Artie were easy to work with and have great customer service skills.

author: Geoffrey Loviza
text: Over the winter, my septic system failed.  I contacted Maggio and Sons, and from the beginning they were professional and provided exceptional service.  Steve explained everything that needed to be done, provided me with contact information of several different engineering firms and assisted with the permit process.  They were fully transparent and fair about pricing and when the work began, the quality was top-notch and finished far sooner than I anticipated.  With everything finished they even saved time to offer suggestions and cost estimates on some additional excavation projects I am considering.  I highly recommend Maggio and Sons for any of the many services they provide.
